observed_prior_mtp_gate.interpretation: This proves that the prior MTP3 candidate cleared its retained functional gates. It does not prove that the nested speculative attention_backend selected Triton, and it does not validate dynamic FP8 KV.

dynamic_fp8.scale_calculation: automatic per token and head in the Triton cache-write kernel; no calculate-kv-scales flag

comparison_contract: Run the BF16 Triton control before the FP8 candidate.
Keep model revision, runtime image, 16K context, C1, graph mode, MTP3, multimodal limits, prompts, and measurement controls identical.
Change only the KV cache dtype between the two target-Triton arms.
Leave speculative_config.kv_cache_dtype unset in both arms. An explicit BF16 draft override would create a mixed target/draft cache layout and reduce the capacity benefit.
Capture resolved startup backend and cache dtype evidence. Do not attribute draft Triton selection to the nested key.
Require text, reasoning, tools, vision, cache-capacity, and near-limit context evidence before retaining an FP8 recommendation.

findings_summary.finding: The existing nested speculative attention_backend requests TRITON_ATTN, but the exact pinned standard MTP path does not apply that field through load_eagle_model. Prior successful MTP startup and quality gates therefore do not prove a Triton drafter.

An explicit top-level --attention-backend TRITON_ATTN selects Triton for the target and, through the pinned standard MTP inheritance path, for the MTP head. This is the supported basis for the matched BF16 and FP8 candidates.

TRITON_ATTN with fp8_per_token_head is a viable source-admitted candidate on sm120, but no pinned upstream integration test proves the exact Qwen3.5 hybrid, MTP3, graph, multimodal combination. Local startup, correctness, quality, and capacity evidence remain mandatory.

missing_tests: No pinned upstream integration test covers Qwen3.5 hybrid plus MTP3 plus fp8_per_token_head plus sm120.
No pinned upstream integration test covers an image request under that exact combination.
The generic per-token/head kernel tests cover component behavior but cannot establish model-level correctness or quality.

advisory_priors: The prior MTP3 candidate passed 27/30 repeated MMLU-Pro diagnostic attempts with all 30 ending in stop; the three incorrect attempts were the computer-science item.
The prior MTP3 candidate passed 18/18 retained vision attempts.
These observations justify a bounded target-Triton comparison but do not qualify the FP8 candidate or authorize promotion.
recommendation: Run the prepared 16K target-Triton BF16 control, then the otherwise matched fp8_per_token_head candidate with draft KV inheritance. Retain FP8 only if startup identity, functional and vision gates, quality diagnostics, measured cache capacity, and bounded performance evidence pass.
